issue.title: Turn every red sase workflow green
issue.description: On sase-org/sase, Master Gate, Full CI, CI Telemetry, and Publish are green at the master tip, and CI on the open release-please PR is green at its head. Each one is the latest run of its workflow, completed with success on a SHA at or after the last fix, with no in-scope job cancelled or skipped. Green evidence is published as ci_evidence. Otherwise, after a very large and documented effort, a research-sidecar report says exactly what is still needed. Then the land agent closes phase sase-1rq.2 of epic sase-1rq.

issue.title: Stop the coverage-contexts lane crashing on global disk patches
issue.description: coverage-contexts: CI Telemetry's coverage-contexts job dies in a pytest-xdist INTERNALERROR. test_inflight_handler_does_no_synchronous_disk_or_proc_store_work patches os.stat and pathlib.Path methods globally with a raising stub. Coverage's ctrace tracer then calls os.path.exists while the patch is active and hits the assertion inside the tracer. Scope that guard so it only sees the code under test. Audit the other tests that globally patch os, os.path, or pathlib with raising stubs for the same hazard, and prove the cov-contexts lane passes on the affected modules.

payload.entry: PLANNING EVIDENCE: At clean source baseline b7ca9f3450, no prior phase work notes or recent contention repair were found. Python job 128401500987 times out at test_files_anchor_ownership.py:364 in the INITIAL short-extent setup wait, before navigation/re-measurement, not the later anchor wait. sase-1r2.6 notes describe 109 goldens plus capacity/gate fixture fixes, but the repair is absent from master and recent enough to retain its ownership. No source or golden changes. Parent epic-symbol check found no entries. Plan validation and revalidation passed with no warnings.

(2) Publish run 42387581264 (workflow_dispatch, master ef00c509, created 15:41Z, after the 14:58Z 0.44.0 upload) concluded success: release + sync-release-metadata both success; ratchet log 'PINNED(0.44.0, files=...)' and 'sase-core-rs ratchet ==0.43.2 -> ==0.44.0 applied', pushed bc1b8dcc..4bcb3e4c 'chore: sync release metadata' to release-please--branches--master (pyproject now sase-core-rs==0.44.0). The preceding CI run 42387852230 on bc1b8dcc (release-please refresh before the sync push) failed floor smoke as expected and is superseded. (4) Master pin still c8adc878 at tip b7ca9f34; Core Pin Ratchet PR #319 (-> dec432ca) still open. (5) Correction for verify: lint/test/visual-test/perf-floors/ace-page-group-isolation/build-core on the release PR are SKIPPED BY DESIGN, not gated by floor smoke: build-core.yml:62-66 skips source-mode build-core on release-please--branches--master ('its core comes from the floor-smoke leg instead'), every other job needs build-core; docs-build (ci.yml:328) and tutorial-tests (ci.yml:710) are excluded on PRs by their own if:. So the release PR's CI does not depend on the full-ci phase. Master has since moved to b7ca9f34, so the next Publish will refresh #322 again; verify should re-read that run.

ROOT-CAUSED both Master Gate reds (no quarantine). (1) test_epic_panel_arrival_frames::test_selection_stays_highlighted_and_scrolled_into_view (run 42373447720, test (3)): 0/54 local repros under taskset 1-2 CPU contention, but tracing showed #agent-list-container transiently grows one row (23->24) in a layout pass; an insert landing in that window needs no scroll, and when the container shrinks back Textual only clamps scroll, so the selection stays off-screen unless a later refresh highlight pass happens to re-scroll. Forcing that ordering in the real harness (terminal +1 row before plain_member, -1 after it settles) reproduces CI verbatim ("frame 11: row 14 outside scroll 2+12") without the fix and passes with it. Fix: AgentList._size_updated re-scrolls a highlight that was visible before a resize and is not after (user scroll-away left alone); new tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_list_resize_keeps_highlight.py (2 of 3 fail without the fix). Targeted visual check (9 agents-tab files, 48 goldens): captures byte-identical with and without the fix; the 13 drifts there are pre-existing sase-1r2.6 territory. (2) test_event_driven_pause_fixture::test_fixture_patch_does_not_leak_from_previous_test (run 42386100885, test (7)): order-dependent on a sibling test under run_pytest --dist worksteal; fails deterministically when run alone on the unchanged tree. Rewritten order-independent: asserts the fixture wrapper __wrapped__ is the real pause (plus the sentinel check when the override test ran first); verified it now catches a real leak from a non-TUI test that the old assertion missed. sase tool run check 28399ac1 passed.

PROGRESS: CI Telemetry run 42377692789 coverage-contexts had exactly one failure: the known xdist INTERNALERROR crashitem on test_inflight_handler_does_no_synchronous_disk_or_proc_store_work (1 failed / 56559 passed, no .coverage uploaded). Root cause reproduced locally with tools/run_pytest cov-contexts (ctrace): a prior sys.path change makes coverage _should_trace -> set_matchers_depending_on_syspath -> _analyze_directory -> os.path.exists hit the raising os.stat stub inside the tracer, giving the identical worker_workerfinished crashitem. Also proved a second hazard: any fixture-scoped raising os.stat/Path.exists(/Path.stat on 3.12) patch turns the guarded test's own failure into an INTERNALERROR via pytest reporting (linecache os.stat, Code.path Path.exists). Fix: new tests/_sync_io_guard.forbid_sync_file_io (patches only inside a with block, calling thread by default, records+raises only when the nearest attributable frame is sase code; coverage/_pytest/pluggy/xdist/execnet frames pass through; swallowed calls still fail on exit), self-tested in tests/test_sync_io_guard.py. Converted: kill-and-edit in-flight test, test_node_finder_preview tier0, test_deck_empty_availability files probe, test_prompt_path_inventory @ keystroke, test_snippets_panel j/k (any_thread=True to keep its every-thread contract), pager test_link_context merge, test_agent_wait_epic_follow_model no-io; test_vcs_provider_git_core missing-file uses a path-keyed exists fake instead of side_effect=[True, False]. Left alone (harmless): OSError/PermissionError fault injections, path-filtered stubs (check_exists plan:, forbidden_open target-only), pure return-value fakes, with-scoped Path-only patches. Proved the guard: injected Path.is_dir and a swallowed os.listdir into _begin_inflight_deferred_kill -> test failed with the call site, not INTERNALERROR (reverted). Evidence: cov-contexts on the 9 touched files 102 passed, 0 INTERNALERROR, .coverage written, 0 phantom files; sase tool run check a3083d5dcfdc281cd6ce11da9ff8ad8e succeeded. Remaining: cov-contexts tests/ace/tui neighbour run (monitored).

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: feature — lint new process-wide raising os/os.path/pathlib/builtins patches in tests — a cheap AST check (like lint (test waits)) flagging monkeypatch.setattr/patch of os.stat/os.lstat/os.getcwd/os.path.*/pathlib.Path.exists|stat with a non-OSError raising stub or a side_effect list, pointing authors at tests/_sync_io_guard.forbid_sync_file_io; prevents the coverage-contexts INTERNALERROR class from returning.

Master Gate green from fix commit c732c6e3 onward: run 42392919193 (c732c6e3, the fix: AgentList._size_updated re-scrolls a highlight that a viewport shrink hid, plus an order-independent rewrite of test_fixture_patch_does_not_leak_from_previous_test) = success, every job success; next push run 42393473755 (ab6b14fb) = success. Earlier reds 42373447720 (test_selection_stays_highlighted_and_scrolled_into_view) and 42386100885 (pause-fixture leak test ordering under worksteal) were root-caused: the first was reproduced deterministically (grow -> insert -> shrink), the second fails every time when run alone on the clean tree. Both pass with the fix. sase tool run check 28399ac1 passed. No epic symbols remain. No workflow, timeout or gate setting was changed.

NEIGHBOUR RUN GREEN (monitor 942z8cnr6t6y, tool run 47f704881537010f0dceafee045b5f1f): COVERAGE_CORE=ctrace tools/run_pytest cov-contexts tests/ace/tui on fix commit ab6b14fb8b -> exit 0, 18770 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 42 warnings, 778.63s pytest (13m13s wall); zero real INTERNALERROR lines (the 5 grep hits are the monitor header/echo text), no xdist worker crash/replacement; .coverage written (108,756,992 bytes).

Fix landed in ab6b14fb8b: tests/_sync_io_guard.forbid_sync_file_io scopes no-disk guards to the calling thread and sase-originated callers, 7 guard tests converted plus a side_effect list on os.path.exists replaced, with self-tests in tests/test_sync_io_guard.py. Verified: guard still catches injected raw and swallowed disk reads; cov-contexts on the touched files 102 passed with no INTERNALERROR, and coverage report reads the DB with no phantom files; sase tool run check passed; full cov-contexts tests/ace/tui (ctrace) run 942z8cnr6t6y: exit 0, 18770 passed, 0 failed, no INTERNALERROR or worker crash, .coverage written. No epic-symbol leftovers.

COORDINATION (from files-reserve phase sase-1rq.2.1.5.1.1): the Files node test_files_anchor_ownership.py::test_trailing_reserve_remeasures_when_flag_already_enabled (task sase-1qd) is root-caused and fixed by that phase: Textual 8 refresh(layout=True) does not advance the box-model cache key while a layout is already pending, so a screen reflow that measured the spread first made the remeasure a no-op; refresh_section_layout_reserve now also clears _box_model_cache. If the contention lane meets this node, reuse that fix (look for the sase-1rq.2.1.5.1.1 commit on master) rather than quarantining it.

PROGRESS (subset-validated; full `just test-cost` handed to a monitor). Base b7ca9f34, Python 3.14.7 locally (CI is 3.13), 3 workers.

Root cause: the leak detector, not the recorder. Frozen subset: tests/ace/tui/modals + tests/ace/tui/actions + tests/ace/tui/models + tests/history = 3,656 items. Pytest-reported time / CPU-s per arm:
- before: fast 247.2s/541, recorder-only 244.4s/542, detector-only 684.0s/1888, cost (both) 668.3s/1827 (rc 1: 20 poisonings)
- after: fast 214.8s/498, recorder-only 230.9s/506, detector-only 361.9s/912, cost (both) 353.0s/904 (rc 0, 0 poisonings)
- cost/fast 2.70x -> 1.64x; cost-lane overhead 421s -> 138s wall and 1286 -> 406 CPU-s (~3x). Recorder contribution is immaterial in both, so CostRecorder was left unchanged.

Why: per-test cost = 2 snapshots. In dirty TUI workers (~4,000 sase modules, ~125k bindings) the binding scan + cache probe is only ~25ms; the rest was re-repr'ing large cache values every snapshot: sase.ace.testing._stylesheet_cache._CACHE (~88ms, a 2MB repr) and sase.ace.tui.util.lazy_syntax caches (up to 430ms). Snapshot was 123-603ms per call before; census after the fix: median 68-79ms, p90 86-115ms, max 124ms.

Changes:
1. tests/_global_state_leaks: exact fast paths. Snapshots are byte-identical to HEAD's (verified on 2,811- and 6,435-module states). Exact-type dispatch with a type-first check; bounded name-classification cache; import-checked cache-protocol-free builtin types; short-circuited probe (no cache_clear lookup without cache_info); per-snapshot alias memo that holds the object, so it is safe against id reuse; bounded identity reuse only for compiled patterns and frozensets of immutable scalars; cheaper container repr with a safe fallback; slots fingerprints; the diff skips unchanged names. Microbench 1.5-1.85x; in-worker A/B of snapshot CPU 1.35x before the cache fixes.
2. src/sase/ace/testing/_stylesheet_cache.py: the cached snapshot is one zlib-compressed pickle (immutable bytes, ~160KB), so the detector observes it exactly at ~1ms. AcePage hydrate dropped from ~183ms (deepcopy) to ~49ms. One pickle keeps RuleSet identity shared between rules and rules_map. 12 targeted PNG goldens are unchanged with 1 worker (11 hydrated boots).
3. tests/_conftest_runtime.py: per-test clearing of leaked caches, following the existing _reset_derived_config_caches pattern: _ASSOCIATED_PLAN_SHEET_{CACHE,SIGNATURES}, which caused all 20 subset poisonings via temp plan paths (changed-value), and the three bounded lazy_syntax render caches.
4. tests/ace/tui/modals/test_agent_action_chooser_modal.py::test_chooser_arms_enter_after_recovery_panel_opens failed once in a loaded cost run (0.3s wall-clock arm window) and passed 5/5 focused. Root-cause fix: a 30s window and an aged mount stamp, no sleep.
5. New tests: tests/test_global_state_leak_snapshot.py (18 real-snapshot tests covering same-size/nested in-place edits, rebinding/deleting/kind change, late/replaced modules, aliases with work counts, immutable-only reuse, LRU warm/clear/replace, cache APIs attached after a negative probe, broken cache APIs, probe short-circuit, env hashing, cwd/sys.path, a clean gate, xdist fail-gate aggregation, xdist report-only, id-recycling guards) and tests/test_ace_stylesheet_snapshot.py. Mutation-checked: 7/7 targeted regressions caught.

Verification: `sase tool run check` dd4ef391388cd5135dab1cd136944c56 escalated to the full suite (root conftest). All lint stages passed. 60,478 passed, 1 failed: tests/test_agent_name_registry_rebuild_pending.py::test_registry_rebuild_keeps_live_identity_pending_claim, triaged FLAKY (no_new_failures). It passes 3/3 focused on the same tree.

CI projection, not verified: Full CI test (3.13) took ~52 min including setup, versus a projected ~193 min for test-cost. A ~3x smaller detector overhead suggests roughly 95-110 min. The verify phase owns proof.
